definitions.explanation: Cables used to transmit electrical power over long distances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{架空|かくう}→架空：00160_kakuu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct an inspection of overhead power lines.

examples.japanese: {送電線|そうでんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't go near the high-voltage power lines.

notes:
{送電線|そうでんせん} refers specifically to the high-voltage cables that carry electricity over long distances from power plants to substations. It is more specific than ⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧, which is a general term for any electric wire or cable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{架空|かくう}→架空：00160_kakuu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}: overhead power line
- ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧{送電線|そうでんせん}: high-voltage power line
- {送電線|そうでんせん}{鉄塔|てっとう}: transmission tower/pylon
- {送電線|そうでんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to string power lines

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧: electric wire, power line (general term)
- ⟦{配電線|はいでんせん}→配電線：26750_haidensen⟧: distribution line (lower voltage, to homes)
- ⟦{送電|そうでん}→送電：17225_souden⟧: power transmission
- {鉄塔|てっとう}: steel tower, pylon
